title: PDV Phase 20 Imperial civic Nine Divines, focused patron, and Talos pressure implementation costing
paceAssumption: Imperial keeps a real active-patron piety faucet (one of only three, with Nord and Altmer). Assume ~2 qualifying civic signals per honest-play day, each contributing a small piety delta toward the active patron, yielding roughly 12 days from cold start to Devoted at steady honest civic play. This matches the Nord ~12-day-to-Devoted pace; Talos faithful-defiance acts are deliberately rarer and costlier and do not accelerate the broad faucet.
designRules: Imperial broad worship is civic and institutional, not Nord mythic breadth; the Nine Divines lane is a single broad family, not a per-patron stack.
Rewards gate on the IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible pattern: patron piety Tier >= threshold AND an active patron. There is no substrate track.
ConcordatStanding is political/theological pressure that modifies access, offer priority, and Talos pressure; it is never a parallel always-on buff track.
Talos favor comes from faithful defiance only. Compliance may alter standing and civic access, never Talos favor.
Civic acts must be concrete, whitelisted devotional events; faction membership, rank, generic temple attendance, ordinary bounty payment, and generic anti-Thalmor violence never score.
Concordat-Enforcer cruelty and civic compromise corrode Arkay/Stendarr through medium/major creed-violation signals only, never raw ambient stat punishment.
Keep at most two always-on boon families: broad Nine Divines (Layer 1) plus one focused primary patron (Layer 2); broad stays softer than focused.

notes: Modifies Talos offer access, civic access, and public/private pressure tilt; it is NOT a reward boon track.
Costly faithful Talos defiance moves a compliant character at least to PrivateDefiant on acceptance.
ConcordatEnforcer is the cruelty/compliance pole that gates Arkay/Stendarr creed-violation loss until mercy or death-rite repair signals exist.
Walk-back from ConcordatEnforcer requires sustained counter-behavior and a story-caliber reset, not a single mercy act.

triggerSurfaces.name: PDV IMPERIAL TALOS PRESSURE SIGNAL

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Imperial devotion is civic and institutional: concrete service, mercy, lawful order, honest work, and burial feed a real piety faucet, while Talos faithful defiance and ConcordatStanding shape pressure, not a parallel buff track.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Civic acts are whitelisted, concrete devotional events feeding the active patron, not faction rank or generic temple attendance.
Talos favor comes only from costly faithful defiance filtered by ConcordatStanding; compliance and generic anti-Thalmor violence never score.
feedbackSurface: Concordat band messages and the civic Survey copy explain Uncommitted, Private Defiant, Open Defiant, Public Compliant, and Concordat Enforcer.
Civic-service and Talos notifications teach which concrete acts scored and why faction/attendance/bounty did not.
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A non-combat Imperial can feel devotionally noticed through public service, mercy, lawful order, honest work, and burial, reaching Devoted at a Nord-comparable pace without grinding faction attendance.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before reward expansion, prove one civic-act faucet loop, the public/private Talos pressure edge under ConcordatStanding, focused-patron credit, and rejected cases for faction/attendance/bounty/anti-Thalmor violence.

rules: ConcordatStanding band readback is present and treated as access/pressure modifier, not a buff track, before runtime work
civic-service and focused-patron faucet hooks are costed with exactly one anti-farm mechanism each before deeper reward expansion
Talos routes reference only faithful-defiance source families filtered by ConcordatStanding; compliance never scores Talos favor
rejected hook families (faction, attendance, bounty-alone, anti-Thalmor violence, cruelty-as-order) are converted into verifier or runtime negative cases before build completion
creed-violation loss fires only on medium/major authored civic-compromise, Enforcer-cruelty, and death-duty beats
at most two always-on boon families exist: broad Nine Divines plus one focused patron; broad stays softer than focused

positive: an honest civic Imperial can reach Devoted via concrete public service, mercy, lawful order, honest work, and burial at a Nord-comparable pace
costly faithful Talos defiance scores and moves a compliant character at least to Private Defiant on acceptance
a focused patron receives one loud civic favor lane while broad Nine Divines stays softer
Concordat-Enforcer cruelty and civic compromise corrode Arkay/Stendarr with readable creed-loss messages
negative: faction membership, rank, or generic temple attendance does not move civic piety
ordinary bounty payment, generic mercy, or generic lawfulness does not score civic faith
generic anti-Thalmor violence, generic Talos proximity, or compliance does not grant Talos favor
ConcordatStanding does not act as a second always-on buff track, and vampire state does not become a cleaner civic route

firstImplementationSlice: Define the PDV_RepTrack_ConcordatStanding band readback (Uncommitted/PrivateDefiant/OpenDefiant/PublicCompliant/ConcordatEnforcer) before civic reward work.
Wire the civic-service faucet (public service, mercy, lawful order, honest work, death-duty) with one anti-farm mechanism per act and active-patron offer gating.
Wire public/private Talos faithful-defiance pressure filtered by ConcordatStanding, reusing PDV_Deity_Talos.
Add the focused-patron civic-favor lane with a manager stack cap so broad Nine Divines does not inherit every patron boon.
Add negative tests for faction membership, generic temple attendance, bounty-alone, generic anti-Thalmor violence, and cruelty-as-order.
